newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Clinton to announce Mideast summit -Israel Radio.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to announce Mideast summit -Israel Radio.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton will announce an Arab-Israeli summit to take place in Washington on Tuesday, Israel Radio said.

It said Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Palestinian President Yasser Arafat, Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak and Jordan's King Hussein would join Clinton at the meeting aimed at salvaging Middle East peace following bloody Arab-Israeli clashes.

"Soon we'll go to a live broadcast of the president of the United States' announcement on the summit the day after tomorrow, Tuesday, in the White House, with the participation of the president of the United States, the prime minister of Israel, the head of the Palestinian Authority, the president of Egypt, and the king of Jordan"
The White House said earlier that Clinton would have a statement at 1230 GMT on the Middle East. The White House did not elaborate.
Nearly 70 Palestinians and Israeli soldiers have been killed in gunbattles and protests sparked by the opening of a tunnel in Jerusalem near Islam's third holiest site.
U.S. and U.N. officials had been trying to arrange a summit to end the bloodshed.
